meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你从现有成果出发，筛选有潜力的深度学习新方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做研究中已有一定的对比结果，想探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Find and vet novel deep learning research directions from your current results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have baselines and want to explore new research ideas

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 在你已有明确研究锚点（任务、数据、评测基准与 SOTA 参考）时，执行受控的候选探索：先理解仓库并筛选想法，再逐个进行有界小实验，与当前基线对比后把结果写入 `analysis_outputs/`、`sources/` 与 `explore_outputs/`，并附上科学变更与可比性报告。不宣称自动发现，只作为待验证假设。
howto.when: 当你已定好任务、数据集、评测与 SOTA 参考，并明确要求只做候选探索（如跑几个变体、孤立分支），且已有 `current_research` 锚点（分支/提交/已训练模型）时触发。

say.text: 基于当前分支，冻结数据集和评测，探索 3 个候选并排序。
say.note: Claude 会先确认锚点并执行外环筛选。

say.text: 保留我的想法，另加两个单变量候选，分别跑一次小实验。
把本次候选改动和评测写入 explore_outputs，附科学变更说明。
say.note: 让结果可审计，便于后续复核。

howto.what_en: Guides candidate deep-learning research exploration on an existing anchor: freeze task/eval, understand repo, gate ideas, run one bounded experiment, then write audit outputs. Novelty stays hypothetical.
howto.when_en: Triggered when task, dataset, evaluation and SOTA are already fixed and the user explicitly wants candidate-only exploration (e.g., variants, isolated branch) with a current_research anchor.

say_en.text: Based on current branch, freeze dataset and evaluation, explore 3 candidates and rank.
say_en.note: Claude confirms anchor and runs outer-loop idea gating.

say_en.text: Keep my idea, add two single-variable candidates, run a small experiment for each.
say_en.note: Triggers explore-code/explore-run execution and evidence collection.

say_en.text: Write candidate changes and eval results into explore_outputs with a changelog.
